classification.difficultyReason: Obtains the factor from the specified point and applies the equation in either direction to complete the table, with explicit rounding instructions.

content.prompt: This conversion graph relates miles per hour $M$ and kilometres per hour $K$.

spec.description: Straight conversion line through the origin and the marked point (62,100), with arrowed axes, complete labelled scales and a square grid. The source title is retained in sentence case.
spec.mathematics: K=(50/31)M; horizontal labels 10 through 70 in steps of 10; vertical labels 0 through 120 in steps of 20; minor grid steps 2.5 mph and 5 km/h.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied line and marked point are permanent student-visible givens; no calculated equation is printed in the graph.

inlines.text: Use the equation to fill in the table below. Round to 1 d.p.
